title: Ricardo Custódio
text:
Professor · Researcher · Advisor · Consultant
Information Security · Cryptography · Digital Signatures ·
Digital Identity · Electronic Documents · AI & Security


My research interests include information security, cryptography, digital signatures, public key infrastructure, digital identity, electronic documents, post-quantum cryptography, finite field arithmetic, and artificial intelligence applied to security.
